scope: Seven paired external benchmark families; adapted function bodies, added stdio wrappers, bounded domains. Controls and bug locations are known. Not independent student submissions or unseen holdout. Source is external, task adapters and oracle implementations authored for this project.

manifest.title: QuixBugs gcd
manifest.statement: Read two integers a,b in 0..40; print their greatest common divisor, with gcd(0,0)=0.

manifest.title: QuixBugs get_factors
manifest.statement: Read n in 1..60; print its prime factors in ascending order with repetitions, separated by spaces; print an empty line for 1.

package.reference:
n=int(input())
out=[]
for i in range(2,n+1):
    while n%i==0:
        out.append(i)
        n//=i
print(*out)

manifest.statement: Read n in 1..30; print all primes no greater than n, separated by spaces.

package.reference:
n=int(input())
print(*(x for x in range(2,n+1) if all(x%d for d in range(2,x))))

manifest.title: QuixBugs kth
manifest.statement: Read exactly four integers -5..5, then k in 0..3; print the zero-based kth smallest element, counting duplicates.

manifest.title: QuixBugs quicksort
manifest.statement: Read n in 1..6, then n integers in -3..3; print all integers in ascending order including duplicates.

package.reference_alt:
def quicksort(arr):
    if not arr:
        return []

    pivot = arr[0]
    lesser = quicksort([x for x in arr[1:] if x < pivot])
    greater = quicksort([x for x in arr[1:] if x >= pivot])
    return lesser + [pivot] + greater

n=int(input())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
print(*quicksort(a))
